input.command:
cd /app && python3 2>&1 <<'PY' | grep -vi warning
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pgmpy.models import LinearGaussianBayesianNetwork as L

d = pd.read_csv('bn_sample_10k.csv')

# DAG: U root -> all; Y->D (D first alphabet=child); R->M (M first=child)
edges = [('U','Y'),('U','R'),('U','M'),('U','D'),('Y','D'),('R','M')]  # (from,to)

# 1) save learned_dag.csv  to,from
pd.DataFrame([(t,f) for f,t in edges], columns=['to','from']).to_csv('learned_dag.csv', index=False)

model = L(edges)
model.fit(d)
model.check_model()

# intervened DAG: remove incoming edges to Y
inter = model.do('Y', inplace=False)
ie = list(inter.edges())
pd.DataFrame([(t,f) for f,t in ie], columns=['to','from']).to_csv('intervened_dag.csv', index=False)
print('intervened edges', ie)

# sample 10k from intervened BN, Y set to 0.0
samp = model.simulate(n_samples=10000, do={'Y':0.0}, seed=42)
samp = samp[list(d.columns)]
samp.to_csv('final_bn_sample.csv', index=False)
print('Y mean/var', samp['Y'].mean(), samp['Y'].var())
print(samp.describe())
PY
cd /app && for f in learned_dag.csv intervened_dag.csv final_bn_sample.csv; do echo "== $f =="; head -3 $f; wc -l $f; done
